caption:
OpenAI has introduced the GPT-Live-1 API, enabling developers to create applications that can simultaneously talk and listen. This new speech model can enhance user interactions, as seen with Yelp's improved call handling. With full-duplex capabilities, GPT-Live-1 outperforms its predecessors significantly in various benchmarks. 

Are you excited about the potential of live interaction with AI?

Sources: The Decoder, OpenAI
